applications.content: Formal binder arguments are scoped to the compiled caller/callee pair. The source site and associated passage are selected editorially. Paper equivalence uses the fidelity records.

axiom-audits.json.content: Lean reports transitive axioms for inspected declarations. Theorem hypotheses are visible in the formal type.

checks.json.content: Each configuration identifies its challenge, solution, permitted axioms and recorded outcome.

corpus/lean_dependencies.json.content: Constant dependencies from types and bodies. See traversal_scope and hidden_paths.

declaration_titles.content: Reading labels for named declarations. Statement correspondence and Lean evidence are recorded separately.

fidelity.content: Reviewer, effective relation, hypotheses and review freshness apply to each individual tie.

papers.content: Quartic manuscripts use exact Markdown from the edition. The original is OpenAI’s pinned PDF.

proof_graph.content: Lean reports the constants used in types and proofs. Paper links and reading notes are authored.

routes.content: Paragraph and topic selections across accounts. Editorial reading suggestions.

semantic_probes.content: A probe tests the named example or alternative definition. An empty list means no indexed probe.

statement_presentations.content: Titles and readable restatements of the maintained ledger wording, bound by its digest.
